# Synthetic parser fixtures

The marker-update fixtures describe the expected output format after the reachability-marker
changes. They were adapted from historical RESULT lines, not generated by
ProVerif. They validate runner parsing only and do not establish query outcomes.
The original outputs/ captures remain unchanged. Run the actual models under
ProVerif 2.05 to validate the revised markers.

The two emergency_containment fixtures are new intended 32-query contracts for
the composed models. They are also synthetic, not verifier output.
